name: application-price-calendar
title: Price Calendar
description: Month grid showing a fare or price beneath each day with a cheapest-day highlight, driven by a typed days prop contract.
useWhen: Travel or booking flows where the price varies by day and users benefit from seeing all days' fares at once.
You want to highlight the single cheapest day in the visible month to guide flexible-date shoppers.
Users need to both browse fares and select a specific date from the same grid.
avoidWhen: Price doesn't vary by day — use a plain Date Picker instead, which doesn't need the extra fare row.
You need a compact glanceable widget without day-level interaction — use the Mini Calendar Widget instead.
Users need to compare a date range's total cost rather than single-day prices — pair with a Date Range Picker and a computed total instead.
responsiveBehavior: The 7-column day grid scales within its container; on narrow viewports the per-day price label may need to shrink further or be hidden below a minimum cell width.
accessibility: The cheapest day uses aria-current in addition to its green tint, and the selected day uses aria-pressed in addition to its filled background — neither state relies on color alone.
Each day cell shows the price as visible text beneath the date number, not only as a tooltip or hover reveal.
The bottom legend restates the cheapest/selected meaning with both a swatch and a text label.

variants.title: Price Calendar
variants.description: Month grid with a fare shown under each day, a highlighted cheapest day, a selected-day fill, and month navigation controls.
accessibility: The cheapest-day highlight and selected-day fill are both reinforced by aria attributes, not color alone.

variants.title: Price Calendar (Dark)
variants.description: Fare calendar adapted for dark surfaces with the same per-day price, cheapest-highlight, and selection structure.
accessibility: Day text, fare text, and the cheapest/selected fill colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
